P-1.1.title: Small change to non-critical modules without approval

P-1.6.title: Emergency clause
P-1.6.scope: smallest fix within P-1.1 / P-1.3 per-action scope

P-1.7.title: Module criticality classification is immutable to the agent

interpretations._note: Implementation readings of P-1 text that the text does not settle. Each is recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md. They are NOT part of the user's policy and may be overridden only by the user.
interpretations.emergency_exempts_cumulative_budget_ref: D-22 (Gem's ruling 2 Oct 2026: the former exemption is withdrawn; emergencies are never authorised beyond the remaining cumulative budget)
interpretations.emergency_below_floor_escalates_ref: D-22 (Gem's ruling 2 Oct 2026): during a valid P-1.6 emergency, if P-1.5 max_lines_non_critical - used < P-1.1 max_lines_per_action (50), the fix is REQUIRES_ESCALATION / P-1.5 (budget_review, emergency_clause P-1.6) instead of being authorised under a 50-line floor
interpretations.emergency_per_action_limit_up_to_remaini: D-22 (Gem's ruling on F-09, 2 Oct 2026): during a valid P-1.6 emergency the non-critical per-action limit is max(P-1.1 max_lines_per_action, P-1.5 max_lines_non_critical - used); critical modules still escalate (P-1.2); emergency lines still count toward P-1.5
